coaching.headline: Sparrow killed Legion six times and Adele three, and the team took both Fangtooths and the Mini Prime without losing a structure.

flags.text: Sparrow was a damn wrecking ball: 11 kills on one death and 20677 hero damage, the game's most.
Duo deaths before minute ten: zero for Sparrow and Zinx, four for Legion and Adele.
Wukong dealt 13562 of the team's 23994 objective damage and destroyed the offlane and mid outer towers.
No tower followed Mini Prime or the second Fangtooth within ninety seconds; the offlane outer followed the first.

focus.title: Walk every neutral to a tower
focus.action: After every Fangtooth or Mini Prime, group on the nearest standing outer tower before the team resets or farms, and call the target lane on the walk out of the pit.

16.2.call: Two separate plays, not one fight: Serath killed Steel on the offlane, and Lt. Belica killed Renna on the mid lane. Fangtooth went to the team in the same window.

19.5.call: Sparrow killed Greystone on the duo lane and Wukong killed Legion in the allied jungle, won 2-0. Sparrow is credited with the enemy duo inner tower within the minute.

21.3.call: Lt. Belica killed Renna on the mid lane and Sparrow killed Legion in the enemy base, won 2-0. Wukong is credited with the mid outer tower and Sparrow with the duo inhibitor in the same window.

254f46e6-69ec-4a87-85ec-a12aab6f9135: First blood and three kills on Greystone, two deaths against a norm near four, and 15605 hero damage, second only to Sparrow.
Both deaths went to Serath on the offlane in the enemy half, after the enemy offlane outer had fallen. Before pushing that lane, ward the nearby enemy jungle entrance.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Out-earned Serath 12403 gold to 8406 with zero deaths, in a jungle matchup rated unfavored on paper.
One ward placed against a norm of seven, yet three enemy wards cleared, the game's most. If wards were equipped, plant wards at the Fangtooth pit before each spawn.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Credited with the enemy duo inner tower and the game's only inhibitor, on 8.6 CS per minute against a norm of 8.3.
Only death came to Legion outside any detected fight, on the allied-half duo lane. While Adele is unseen, farm that lane only with Zinx in range.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zero deaths, two kills on Renna and 10.2 CS per minute against a norm of 7.9; out-earned Renna 11181 gold to 9140.
Hero damage ran 443 per minute against a norm of 724, a hell of a dip, with Combustion the only finished item. Finish Noxia second next game.
Credited with a Greystone kill on the offlane before mid opened; the enemy duo outer tower fell within ninety seconds. Make that trip again whenever the offlane fight starts.
969e4bfe-f057-4155-bab7-7ee688de9045: Zero deaths, the game's most assists at nine, and a hand in 45 percent of team kills.
Twelve wards, the game's most, still trail a norm of 18.1. With Tranquility's three-ward cap, keep a ward on the allied-half duo lane, where Legion killed Sparrow.

matchup: Legion finished 1/7/0 with 7864 hero damage, and Adele 0/3/1 with 2000.
Adele roots with Imperial Lash and Queen's Garden and mesmerizes with Royal Flourish: the duo's crowd control.
Serath, the enemy dive threat on the backline, healed 8309, the most in the game.
build: Vanquisher, Lightning Hawk and Tainted Rounds sit outside the Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Spectra winning core.
Tainted Rounds reduces the target's healing by 45% on basic attacks, but sat third and last in the build.
Vanquisher executes heroes below 5% health; Lightning Hawk slows 20% on the empowered basic attack.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage projectiles after damaging an enemy hero below 30% health.
Wind-Rider adds attack speed after a dash or on leaving Stealth: Heightened Senses gives Stealth, Pacifier gives the dash.
Sparrow carry Eternals are a toss-up, Thraex with the best odds and Weald tied; Forage with Wind-Rider is Weald's best pair.
augment: Endless Hunt resets basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and grants 1 permanent physical penetration per takedown.
Sun Shards is the field's Best Sparrow carry augment: ricocheting basic attacks with on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness.
crest: Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit, 2.5x against targets under 20% max health; a hero kill unlocks a recast.
Pacifier leans ahead of Eviscerator in the Sparrow carry field. Sound keep.
improvement: Weald, Pacifier and the items stay: eleven kills on one death prove no change.
Sun Shards for Endless Hunt is the field-backed test, giving up takedown cooldown resets for ricochet damage.

matchup: Renna was the mid opponent: 0/2/0 with 4592 hero damage, both deaths to Lt. Belica.
Renna's Stupor mesmerizes and Mortal Coil pulls targets to the epicenter; Neural Disruptor silences in return.
build: Combustion's Pyro hits the target and nearby enemies on ability damage, and damaging heroes shortens the Pyro cooldown.
Wraith Leggings, the third winning-core piece, adds 12% ability damage against heroes below 40% health.
eternal: Aion converts 6% of spell damage on enemy heroes into gold, so low hero damage shrinks the payout.
Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus is Aion's best minor pair; Bottomless Vial pays on River Buff kills.
Lotus holds the best odds in a Lt. Belica mid toss-up with Xyris; Aion ranks third, outside the tie.
augment: Combat Veteran is the field's Best Lt. Belica mid augment: movement speed plus passive experience. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima grants a shield, 20% magical lifesteal and 10% movement speed for 8s.
Typhoon leans ahead in the Lt. Belica mid field with Epoch next; Soulbearer trails both.
improvement: Lotus over Aion is the field-backed Eternal test, giving up the spell-damage gold.
Typhoon over Soulbearer stacks attack speed on basic attacks and dashes at four stacks, giving up the shield.

matchup: Serath was the jungle opponent: 2/2/1, both kills on Steel, deaths to Wukong and Sparrow.
Heaven's Fury makes Serath immune to crowd control and invulnerable during the dash.
The enemy ran four physical damage dealers and one magical; Greystone led enemy hero damage at 12341.
build: Manta Scythe and Infernum are two of three winning-core items; Syonic Echo is the missing third, on a thin 47-game sample.
Infernum ignites at four Kindling stacks for max-health damage, and Furnace adds damage per point of enemy bonus armor.
No completed item adds armor against a four-physical enemy comp.
eternal: Lotus grants a random bonus every two minutes and on every takedown; Immaculate cuts damage taken above 85% health.
Lotus ties in a Wukong jungle toss-up led by Weald, with Demiurge close. Sound keep.
Early Bloom with Immaculate is the best minor pair under Lotus here.
augment: Masterful Mimicry adds a max clone and a Hair stack every 5.5s; the field leans toward Masterful Mimicry. Sound keep.
crest: Nex's Reap dashes and damages nearby heroes, boosted by stored Sow, slowing 20%.
Judgement is the field's Best Wukong jungle crest; Nex sits on few games.
improvement: Judgement over Nex is the field-backed crest swap: an area hit healing per hero struck, giving up the Reap dash.
A zero-death game proves no item change; an armor item third stays the test if Greystone gets ahead.

matchup: Greystone was the lane opponent: 0/6/2 with 12341 hero damage, three deaths to Steel.
Greystone's Make Way shreds physical armor, and Stone Forged Soul enters Stasis and heals more with missing health.
build: Draconum and Sky Splitter sit outside the Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard and Flux Matrix tank core.
Draconum adds 40 physical armor and restores health on takedowns; Sky Splitter deals current-health damage on basic attacks.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage to that hero, less damage taken from that hero.
Alpha's Court adds 6% damage only with no allied hero within 800 units, an odd fit on a frontline.
Nihil leans ahead in the Steel offlane field; Thraex sits on few games.
augment: Heavy Metal is the field's Best: Heavy Punches and Shield Bash add magical damage equal to 10% of total armor. Sound keep.
crest: Saphir's Mantle is the field's Best Steel offlane crest. Sound keep.
Atlas grows size and max health, then adds permanent max health from damage dealt to nearby heroes.
improvement: Nihil over Thraex is the field's lean, trading the mark for Doom stats that build through extended fights.
Tainted Guard in place of Sky Splitter adds armor and health, giving up the current-health damage.

matchup: Duo was Zinx and Sparrow against Adele and Legion; Adele placed four wards to twelve from Zinx.
Adele finished 0/3/1 with 2000 hero damage against 7924 from Zinx.
build: Windcaller's Zephyr gives Zinx and the healed ally 8% movement speed for 1.5s, once per target every 8s.
Galaxy Greaves adds 30 physical armor against a four-physical enemy comp.
The listed winning core, Prophecy, Spectra and Orion, wins 46.7%; no build change proven.
eternal: The engine does not model Exarch; Exarch holds the best odds in a Zinx support toss-up with Thraex.
Healing or shielding grants the target 10% total attack speed and bonus on-hit magical damage, a fit for Sparrow's basic attacks.
Illumination with Fervour is Exarch's best minor pair here. Sound keep.
augment: With Disc Of Demise, Ricochet bounces 25% further, and each hit cuts the current cooldown, 12% per hero.
Heal Matrix leans ahead in the field: two Infuse charges, each healing 15% less.
crest: Tranquility's Grace heals Zinx and nearby heroes and adds 10% damage mitigation for 2s.
Tranquility ties in a toss-up led by Silentium, with Reclamation and Leafsong. Sound keep.
improvement: Heal Matrix over Disc Of Demise is the field-leaned test, trading faster Ricochet stuns for a second Infuse charge.
No crest change proven in a zero-death game.

threats: Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal
